name: Client Onboarding Shell - New Client Kickoff

parameters.content:
## Client Onboarding Shell
Replace each placeholder (NoOp) node below with real nodes as you build this out:

1. Create Client Record -> a CRM / project tool node (HubSpot, Notion, Airtable) creating the client's record
2. Send Welcome Sequence -> an Email / Gmail node sending a welcome email with kickoff info
3. Create Onboarding Tasks -> a project management node (Asana, ClickUp, Trello) creating a standard onboarding checklist

The Webhook Trigger is inactive by default so it's safe to import and edit.

nodes.name: 1. Create Client Record
nodes.notes: Replace with a node that creates the client's record in your CRM or project tool (HubSpot, Notion, Airtable, etc.).

nodes.name: 2. Send Welcome Sequence
nodes.notes: Replace with an Email/Gmail node sending a welcome email with next steps, kickoff call link, and what to expect.

nodes.name: 3. Create Onboarding Tasks
nodes.notes: Replace with a project management node (Asana, ClickUp, Trello) that creates a standard onboarding task checklist for the team.
